Step 1 (library): src/gpumod/services/venv_compat.py exports:
  - CompatStatus enum (OK | DRIFT | MISSING)
  - CompatViolation + CompatResult dataclasses (frozen)
  - read_installed_versions(venv_root) — parses dist-info METADATA files directly (no subprocess, no imports — works when target venv is broken)

Step 2 (doctor CLI): src/gpumod/cli_doctor.py — gpumod doctor venv --service-id <id> [--profile <name>]
  - exit 0: OK or no compat declared (no-op success)
  - exit 1: DRIFT or MISSING with per-line diagnostic on stderr
  - exit 2: unknown service id

Step 3 (compat CLI): src/gpumod/cli_compat.py — gpumod compat list and compat show <name>
  - lists shipped profiles via importlib.resources
  - prints YAML content
